method.title: How the verdict is made
method.1.title: Freeze the claim
method.1.body: Natural language is converted into one canonical StrategySpec before any numerical check starts. Defaults and parsing assumptions remain visible in the Artifact.
method.2.title: Separate the checks
method.2.body: Parameter, data, cost, regime, and decay branches run independently. They cannot read sibling conclusions while producing their first result.
method.3.title: Require evidence
method.3.body: Numerical claims must come from committed local data packages and the deterministic Assay backtester. Routine audits read the runtime cache and do not call PandaData again.
method.4.title: Resolve material tension
method.4.body: Moiré may open at most two discriminating follow-ups. The final verdict is aggregated by deterministic rules and includes provenance, limits, and recovery conditions.
report.verdict.KEEP.title: This strategy can stay in consideration
report.verdict.KEEP.body: The five checks found no issue serious enough to reject the strategy. Use it within the limits stated in this report.
report.verdict.WATCH.title: Usable, with active reservations
report.verdict.WATCH.body: The strategy passed the main checks, but some risks or evidence gaps still need monitoring.
report.verdict.QUARANTINE.title: Pause it, repair it, then review again
report.verdict.QUARANTINE.body: The current problems have a defined repair path. Do not continue until the recovery conditions are met.
report.verdict.RETIRE.title: Stop using this strategy
report.verdict.RETIRE.body: At least one material check failed and there is no verified recovery path yet.
report.verdict.UNVERIFIABLE.title: No reliable decision can be made yet
report.verdict.UNVERIFIABLE.body: Critical evidence is missing. This does not prove the strategy works or fails; it means it cannot yet be verified.
report.keyRisksHint: These findings directly affect whether the strategy should remain in use. Address failures before evidence gaps and reservations.
report.allClearBody: All five checks passed or were not applicable. Use the result within the assumptions and risk disclosures in the full report.
report.claimsIntro: Can the stated performance be reproduced?
report.noRecoveryBody: The report does not require more evidence or a repair review.
report.earlyExitBody: The request completed without unsupported assumptions.
report.question.param-robustness: Does the result survive small parameter changes?
report.question.data-availability: Did the backtest look into the future?
report.question.cost-stress: Does it still work after realistic trading costs?
report.question.regime-dependency: Does performance depend on one market regime?
report.question.homogeneity-decay: Is the signal just a crowded factor in disguise?
report.impact.param-robustness: If a small parameter change breaks performance, the result may be an accident of the historical sample.
report.impact.data-availability: Using constituents or prices that were unknown at the time introduces future information, making the headline result unreliable.
report.impact.cost-stress: Turnover, fees, and slippage consume paper returns. This check asks whether the strategy survives more realistic costs.
report.impact.regime-dependency: A strategy that only wins in one environment can fail quickly when the market regime changes.
report.impact.homogeneity-decay: Strong similarity to common signals suggests crowding and a greater risk that performance will decay.
progress.body: The branches are isolated while they work. A missing data source becomes missing evidence, not an invented number.
